description: Does the team have a translation brief or plan, and does church leadership judge the result to reflect it?
computation_notes: Standard numeric triangulation (triangulated mean + agreement). Not a comparison of translation TYPE — see translation-type-agreement for that.

description: Do translators and church leaders name the same agreed-upon translation type?
computation_notes: Categorical match, not a numeric triangulation — these items are all item_type=descriptive and are never scored. Computed separately in 04_aggregate.py from raw ItemResponse option_codes (not ItemScore) and stored in TranslationTypeAgreement, not CrossLensScore. "no-agreement"/"not-aware"/"other" don't count toward either agreement or disagreement.

description: Team self-confidence vs. consultant/pastor confidence in source-text understanding
computation_notes: Triangulated mean + agreement (max − min). ML-Q9 excluded by design — no ML contribution to this construct. ML-Q10 (response to difficult exegetical questions) is a different construct and is not triangulated here.

description: Team practice in managing consistency vs. consultant confidence in it
computation_notes: Two-source triangulation; agreement is simple difference.

description: Community appeal scores vs. pastor judgment of beauty

description: Community trust vs. consultant/pastor judgment of readiness
contributing_items: CW-Q11, CA-Q11, CV-Q11, CHCC-Q4, CHCC-Q5, CHIP-Q10, CHCP-Q10, CHDL-Q10
computation_notes: Highest-stakes triangulation — proposed as the single most comparable cross-project metric.

description: Community report of emotional/behavioral impact vs. pastor observation of the same in their congregation
contributing_items: CW-Q9, CW-Q10, CA-Q9, CA-Q10, CV-Q9, CV-Q10, CHCP-Q12, CHCP-Q13
computation_notes: Community Q9 (emotional impact) + Q10 (behavioral impact) per medium vs. Community Pastor Q12/Q13, the matching pastor-observation wording. CW/CA/CV-Q7 (community's own use frequency) and CHCP-Q11/Q14 excluded (Decision #24) — Q11 scores the pastor's own ministry language choice, not an observation of congregational frequency, and Q14 is a general catch-all with no Community-side counterpart; both remain scored within Church's own Impact Observation sub-dimension, just not triangulated here.
